connector.name: Hibp by darrenjrobinson
connector.registryDescription: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) API
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package hibp-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the darrenjrobinson account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
